issue_request: FHIR-6937 was a Published Patient Care change request asking to add a description element to AllergyIntolerance because the then-current substance element was a CodeableConcept. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution did not add a new element; it required a fresh-vs-canned fish example and a usage note on substance that additional detail can be included in text.

additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini, and AllergyIntolerance.substance is now recorded as a legacy mapping to AllergyIntolerance.code.
